en.headline: Salt-water main bursts on Kwun Tong Road, slow lane closed for repair
en.dek: A 150-millimetre salt-water pipe supplying flushing water to Yue Man Centre ruptured near Hip Wo Path about 1pm, sending a two-metre jet of water onto the pavement and one lane before crews shut the valve.
body: A underground salt-water main burst on Kwun Tong Road near Hip Wo Path in the early afternoon, spraying a jet of water nearly two metres high onto the pavement and one traffic lane before Water Supplies Department crews arrived and shut off the supply.

The department said it received reports of leakage on the footpath opposite a petrol station and confirmed the pipe was a 150-millimetre salt-water main that serves flushing water to Yue Man Centre. Once the valve was closed the flow stopped. Part of the slow lane towards Yau Tong was temporarily closed for clean-up; drivers were able to use the remaining lanes.

The Transport Department noted traffic was heavy in the area while work continued. The Water Supplies Department said its team would complete repairs as quickly as possible to restore flushing-water supply and reopen the road, and that it was coordinating with the Kwun Tong District Office and building management. By mid-afternoon the slow lane had been reopened and traffic had returned to normal.

zh.headline: 觀塘道鹹水管爆裂噴兩米水柱 慢線一度封閉搶修
zh.dek: 今日下午約1時觀塘道近馬蹄徑一段直徑150毫米鹹水供水管爆裂，水柱高近兩米，影響行人路及一條行車線；水務署關掣後已停止湧水，慢線其後重開。
body: 今日下午約1時，觀塘道往油塘方向近馬蹄徑中國石化油站對開行人路，有地底鹹水管爆裂，噴出近兩米高水柱，大量鹹水淹浸行人路及一條行車線，現場滿布沙石。
水務署接報後派員到場關上水掣進行搶修。署方透過社交專頁表示，經了解確認涉事為一條直徑150毫米鹹水供水管，用作供應沖廁水予裕民中心。關上水掣後現場已停止湧水。受事故影響，觀塘道往油塘方向部分慢線須暫時封閉以進行清理，駕駛人士可使用餘下的行車線。
運輸署亦公布有關封閉安排，指當時上址交通繁忙。水務署表示工程團隊會盡快完成維修，恢復沖廁水供應及重開路面，並已與觀塘民政事務處及相關大廈管理處保持聯繫。至下午約3時半，慢線已重開，交通回復正常。
